text:
Predicates:
Game(x) ::: x is a game.
Company(x) ::: x is a game company.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
OnTop10(y) ::: y is on the Top 10 list.
MadeBy(x, y) ::: x is made by y.
SoldMoreThanOneMillionCopies(x) ::: x sold more than one million copies.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.

Premises:
∃x (Game(x) ∧ Created(x, japaneseGameCompany)) ::: The game the Legend of Zelda was created by a Japanese game company.
∀x (OnTop10(x) → ∃y (MadeBy(y, x) ∧ Company(y) ∧ japaneseGameCompany(y))) ::: All games on the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (SoldMoreThanOneMillionCopies(x) → OnTop10(x)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it will be included in the Top 10 list.
SoldMoreThanOneMillionCopies(theLegendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.

Conclusion:
¬OnTop10(theLegendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda is not on the Top 10 list.
